comparison.objective: Clear a fragile egg from a trivet before placing a pot on it.
comparison.physical_skill: Inspect an obstructed target, relocate a fragile object gently, then place a heavier pot.
comparison.success_condition: Pot upright and fully supported on cleared trivet, egg safely supported, objects released and still; pot–egg contact above 0.20 N fails.
comparison.reason: Tests hazard-aware relocation and placement, not deliberate fracture or recovery of generated fragments.
